# Decision history (generated by experiments/generate_decision_history.py — do not edit by hand)

Generated by `experiments/generate_decision_history.py` on 2026-10-17 at commit 45ba3e5 from the git history of docs/open_decisions.md; do not edit by hand.

When each decision of `docs/open_decisions.md` was recorded and when it closed, read from the 121 versions of the log in the git history (plus the working tree when it differs from HEAD). The commit that first holds a row is the earliest the decision can have been recorded; a date written inside the row is the author's claim and is not read here. A closed decision keeps its id, struck through, so "dropped" means an id the log once carried and no longer does, which is the defect this file exists to show.

**Now:** 73 open, 52 closed, 2 dropped. 12 of the closed decisions were recorded and closed in the same commit, which is the recording lag the log's own header describes.

**Defects in the log as it stands:** dropped ids: 1.5 (last seen before e7d1c60, 2026-10-13), 9.10 (last seen before b387b33, 2026-10-14).
